Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automating Deployments with Ansible

February 22, 2026 9 min read

Ansible is an agentless automation engine that allows provisioning software, configuring settings, and managing application nodes via SSH connections.

1. Agentless Simplicity

Ansible doesn't require installing any background agent daemon on client servers. It only needs Python and an SSH connection to apply configuration plays.

2. Idempotency

Ansible modules ensure tasks are idempotent—running a playbook multiple times will check the server state and only perform edits if changes are needed, preventing unwanted resets.
